scope: Future qualified normalized ADP-ribose hydrolysis percent activity; not binding, ATP synthesis, reporter signal alone or viability
aggregation: Arithmetic technical-replicate mean per concentration within curve; equal concentration weights; never pool plates/runs
model: activity = bottom + amplitude/(1 + 10**(hill*(log10(concentration_M)-log10_midpoint_M))); amplitude>0, hill>0; top=bottom+amplitude
numeric_policy_interpretation: Declared software support envelope, not lab QC or scientific identifiability proof. Bound-active, plateau-unsupported, ill-conditioned or inconsistent optimization results abstain. No CI is computed.
unsupported_observations: Preserve all raw CSV strings; any non-observed planned well causes the entire curve to abstain. No dropping, imputation, censor-limit substitution or concentration extrapolation.
absolute_50_rule: Report only if qualified normalization anchors 100% vehicle and 0% blank, bottom < 50 < top, observed concentration means bracket 50, and fitted crossing is strictly within tested concentrations. It is distinct from fitted relative midpoint.
uncertainty: No confidence intervals, p-values, Ki, efficacy or power. Technical SD is descriptive only; independent experiment IDs are counts of submitted units, not verified independence.
output: One atomic non-overwriting JSON containing original rows, input metadata, input/code/dependency-lock hashes, per-curve states, descriptive aggregates and conditional point estimates. No measured-source ledger mutation.

exit_codes.0: valid input and report published, including curve refusals
exit_codes.2: invalid input, provenance mismatch or output publication failure; no result replaced

delivery_status: Implemented descriptive checkout analyzer in scripts/scripts/assay.py; executable synthetic tests in tests/test_assay.py. Not laboratory-qualified, preregistered, or experimental evidence.

solver.start_bottom: Mean of last two sorted dose means
solver.start_amplitude: Mean of first two dose means minus start_bottom; refuse invalid numeric support, never clip

output_states.refusal_invariant: parameters, relative_midpoint_M and absolute_50_vehicle_M must all be null; preserve reasons and descriptive technical aggregates
output_states.input_error: Reject package before optimization; no result file
output_states.qualified_estimate: Only after all prerequisites and numerical/plateau/bracketing checks; simulated estimates always explicitly software-only

provenance_required: SHA256 of manifest, observation CSV, analysis code, contract, environment lock; Python/NumPy/SciPy versions and UTC generation time; retain manifest artifact hashes. Runtime time/hash changes are not numeric nondeterminism.

lock_plan_projection.serialization: json.dumps(plan, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode(UTF-8); SHA256 lowercase hex
lock_plan_projection.qualification_evidence_sha256: SHA256 referenced by qualification.evidence_artifact_id, else null
lock_plan_projection.construct_sha256: SHA256 referenced by target.construct_artifact_id, else null
lock_plan_projection.plates: Object keyed by plate_id; each value has run_id, independent_experiment_id, conditions_sha256, normalization_id, normalization_formula. conditions_sha256 comes from conditions_artifact_id, else null.
lock_plan_projection.exclusions: Exclude artifact registry as a whole, future raw/control/QC outcomes and lock itself; include selected pre-acquisition hashes above, so no circular or future-data commitment.
